title: Cloudflare Kitesurf agent-first browser on Workers (Browser Run beta)
summary: Cloudflare blog introducing Kitesurf, an agent-first browser on Workers ported from Obscura. CDP-compatible Engine, PageScript, and PageRenderer run in Wasm with per-page isolation, stateless burst components, and free Browser Run beta access.
question_it_answers: How does Cloudflare host an agent browser without per-session Chromium overhead?

claims.text: Kitesurf originated as an Obscura port to Workers and shipped after a twelve-week production build.
claims.evidence: Cloudflare ported Obscura to Workers with AI assistance; after a detailed success plan, prototype worked → 12-week build.
claims.subject: mcp-and-agent-browsers

claims.text: The Engine exposes CDP WebSocket and HTTP REST compatible with Puppeteer, Playwright, and DevTools clients.
claims.evidence: Engine — public CDP WebSocket + HTTP REST; session state; Puppeteer/Playwright/DevTools compatible.
claims.subject: mcp-and-agent-browsers

claims.text: Browser Run CDP docs expose WebSocket /devtools/browser plus HTTP session create/list/new/close endpoints and require a token with Browser Rendering - Edit.
claims.evidence: POST /devtools/browser; GET .../json/list; PUT .../json/new; DELETE close; clients Puppeteer, Playwright, MCP
claims.subject: mcp-and-agent-browsers
